claims.statement: For PSR5 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, signed-object quantum-counted/hash/window pair tree otherwise) has unconditional entire-secret success greater than 2/3 and, on EVERY branch, charged sequential work T=O(n^128 2^(sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n)+2sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-1/4))), jointly with all other bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. All source filters, unsuccessful attempts, bounded private preparations, fully expanded predicate gates, addressing, generation and source/work guards are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2, with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Huge disclosed analytic-prefix constants make no practical runtime claim. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2.
